"Nobody can make Africa great but us," were the words of Africa's richest man Aliko Dangote as he urged Africans to take the fate of their continent in their own hands, rather than relying on foreigners.

In an exclusive interview with BBC Focus on Africa's Nkechi Ogbonna, Dangote answered quick-fire questions on a wide array of topics - from the main problem of the continent to the opportunities for its youth and Africa's main strengths.
